prompt: Create one high-fidelity mobile application UI design mockup, portrait aspect 390:844, crisp full-screen flat screenshot, no device mockup, no perspective, no poster. This is an Operate-mode Family Cookbook application for reviewing a photographed recipe before saving. All visible text English. Synthetic design demonstration. Exact region order: iOS safe status bar; navigation back to Cookbook with title Review recipe; small restrained 'Demo content' label; recipe title 'Demo pancakes'; brief text 'Check every field against the original.'; a Source / Draft segmented control with Draft selected; a compact source thumbnail strip marked 'Original · 1 photo' with an Open source affordance; editable ingredient rows '2½ cups' / 'Flour', '2' / 'Eggs', '250 ml' / 'Milk', and 'Not specified' / 'Salt'. A small labeled note alongside Salt says 'Amount missing in source'. A visible short Steps section with '1. Mix the ingredients.' and '2. Cook in a pan.' Footer contextual text 'Saving makes this recipe available to your household.' then a large reachable 'Save recipe' button above the home indicator. No filled checkmark implying automatic verification. No invented temperature, time, servings, AI accuracy, user statistics, food photograph, sharing feed, charts, or extra product capabilities. Large readable system sans typography, 44pt minimum intended controls, polished spacing, field boundaries and focus hierarchy. Original source thumbnail must be an obviously synthetic clean recipe note bearing the same title and quantities, not a real private document. This is one screen, not multiple views. Preserve the ingredients, proper fractions, labels and region hierarchy exactly. Visual direction: FAMILIAR RECIPE APP, category standard at high quality. Plain white #FFFFFF background, near-black green #202B25 text, leaf green #39734F action color, very pale green #EDF4EE contextual panels. Familiar iOS large-title navigation, standard segmented control, simple rounded rectangular form fields and understated ingredient row separators, generous native spacing. No textile border or archive rules. A straightforward light everyday recipe app: calm, polished and accessible, with a green Save recipe button. Original source shown in a compact familiar thumbnail row. Restrained soft corners, excellent typography, zero decorative food photography, no visual metaphors. The design's value is immediate recognition and clarity.
